mo_ta_cong_viec:
Join our team as a Senior Python Engineer at EPAM Vietnam! We are looking for a dynamic individual to become a part of our rapidly growing team. In this role, you will lead and coordinate with our multicultural engineering team to design and build complex systems from the ground up, contributing to our cutting-edge sales planning tool.
Apply today and be eligible for a one-month sign-on bonus.*
*Terms & Conditions apply.
 
Manage change requests and optimize existing use cases using Python and SQL
Provide operational support, including new country onboarding, report generation and job monitoring
Troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently
Oversee project deployment activities
Conduct data migration tasks
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage interactions with downstream and upstream applications
yeu_cau:
Proficiency in Python programming, including FastAPI, multithreading and data integration and transformation
Experience with at least one Frontend technology is a plus; familiarity with Vue.js is highly preferred.
Expertise in database systems, with a primary focus on Azure SQL Database, for managing and querying data
Familiarity with CI/CD processes using GitHub
Experience in front-end development with a solid understanding of UI/UX principles
Proficiency in both spoken and written English (B2 level) is essential for effective communication within our diverse team
